properties.entry:
Menu from ui-components shows a bar of items, along the top or down the side. Each item is an IMenuItem: its label, maybe an icon and a tooltip, and the link the menu renders for it. ui-components has one for each kind of link: BookmarkableMenuItem leads to a page, AjaxMenuItem calls the server via Ajax, LinkMenuItem with a request of its own. A SubMenu opens more items, which may be submenus too, as deep as you like, and MenuSeparator draws a line between them. MenuLinkPanel puts the icon and the label in the link of an item and its tooltip on it.

Click an item with an arrow to open its submenu; while one of the bar is open, the pointer opens the others, and in a submenu resting on an item opens its own. The keys work as in the menus of a desktop: the arrows along the bar and up and down a submenu, the arrow pointing away opening a submenu, Escape closing it, Home and End, and a letter for the next item starting with it. Choosing an item, a click outside or Tab closes the menus.

The navigation leads to this page with the parameter section: the item of the page shown is marked as current, and so are the items holding it; its submenus open as the pointer rests on them, as in a web site. The side bar opens its submenus in place, those holding the current item from the start, and the server marks the item chosen via Ajax. The settings switch the orientation, the four designs, bar, pills, underline and side bar, and how the submenus open. Everything takes its colors from the theme and its classes from the look, Bootstrap's nav and dropdown-menu in the Bootstrap look, and works under a strict Content Security Policy, without inline style.
Most items call the server via Ajax; File › Start again calls it with a request of its own, and Help › Home page leads to a page. Some items are disabled, and some have tooltips.
Choose an item: those with an arrow open a submenu.
